regime.instructions: Which market regime best describes HYPE right now? State is a compact numeric snapshot of the HYPE-USDT-SWAP perpetual: order book (px), returns in bps (ret_bps), realized vol (vol), trade flow (flow), our position (pos), fundamentals (fund) and market context (mkt). Thesis: Fees grew 31% month over month while the market fell 26%; ~76% of fees fund HYPE buybacks; 15.5x price/holders-revenue. Bear case: Only 25% of supply circulates (FDV/holders-revenue 62x); monthly team unlocks on the 6th; perp volume is cyclical and Lighter/Aster compete on fees.

criteria.trending: Persistent directional move: returns over 1h and 4h share a sign and vol is normal for this asset.
criteria.mean_reverting: Range-bound: short-term moves fade, returns flip sign, vol at or below its 24h level.
criteria.high_vol: Volatility well above its 24h level (vol.ratio high) without disorderly market structure.
criteria.crisis: Disorderly: large 24h drawdown, very high vol, wide spreads or thin depth, one-sided flow, market-wide stress.

criteria.long: Rises: bid support and buying flow while fee momentum stays positive; dips into depth get absorbed.
criteria.short: Falls: market-wide deleveraging or selling into unlock dates overwhelms buyback support.
criteria.neutral: No edge after costs, signals conflict, or the move has already happened.

toxic_flow.instructions: Recent HYPE order flow looks informed or one-sided enough that a position opened now would likely be adversely selected (sweeps through levels, sudden spread widening, trade bursts against the resting book).

State is a compact numeric snapshot of the HYPE-USDT-SWAP perpetual: order book (px), returns in bps (ret_bps), realized vol (vol), trade flow (flow), our position (pos), fundamentals (fund) and market context (mkt). Thesis: Fees grew 31% month over month while the market fell 26%; ~76% of fees fund HYPE buybacks; 15.5x price/holders-revenue. criteria: No setup: conflicting signals, thin or unstable book, or the move already happened.
Weak: one supporting signal, others neutral or mixed.
Good: price action, order flow and fundamentals agree on direction; liquidity is adequate.
Excellent: strong agreement across flow, regime and fundamentals, tight spread, no conflicting risk.

risk_state.instructions: Given our position, drawdown and daily P&L in pos, what is the risk state for HYPE?

criteria.safe: Comfortable room: small inventory, shallow drawdown, daily P&L not near a loss limit.
criteria.near_limit: Drawdown, daily loss or inventory is approaching the levels where we would have to cut.
criteria.reduce: Exposure should be cut now: losses accelerating or inventory too large for current conditions.
